shippingTerms.title: The following shipping conditions apply:
shippingTerms.germanyDesc: Deliveries within Germany are free of charge; no shipping costs are charged.
shippingTerms.euDesc: For deliveries to EU countries, you may use your preferred delivery service; unpaid shipments cannot be processed. Shipping costs to us are not covered or reimbursed. Your repaired device will be shipped back to you as a DHL WeltPaket for EUR 13.99. Delivery by DHL or Austrian Post takes place Monday to Saturday within 2 business days.
shippingTerms.nonEuDesc: We cannot deliver outside the EU.
shippingTerms.trackingDesc: After your repair is completed, you will receive an email with your DHL tracking number so you can track your parcel at any time. Your parcel is transport-insured up to EUR 500.00 against damage or loss.

deliveryTimes.title: Delivery times:
deliveryTimes.info1: Unless another deadline is specified in the respective offer, delivery takes place according to DHL information within Germany in 1-3 business days, and for international deliveries in 2-5 business days after conclusion of contract (for advance payment, after your payment instruction). No deliveries are made on Sundays and public holidays. Please note that we have no influence over delivery times and delivery may be delayed by DHL depending on parcel volume.
deliveryTimes.info2: If you ordered items with different delivery times, we ship the goods in one combined shipment unless we have made different arrangements with you. In this case, the delivery time is determined by the item with the longest delivery time in your order.
deliveryTimes.info3: For self-collection, we will inform you by email or phone about the availability of the goods and collection options.

paymentMethods.invoiceDesc: Payment by invoice is only available for public authorities and companies. The invoice amount must be paid within 7 days.

paymentMethods.creditCardDesc: When paying by credit card, your credit card account is charged when the goods are shipped.

batteryDisposal.title: Battery Disposal Notice
batteryDisposal.intro: In connection with the sale of batteries or the delivery of devices that contain batteries, we are obliged to inform you of the following:
batteryDisposal.returnInfo: As an end user, you are legally required to return used batteries. You can return used batteries that we carry or have carried as new batteries in our product range free of charge to our shipping warehouse (shipping address).
batteryDisposal.symbolsIntro: The symbols shown on batteries have the following meaning:
batteryDisposal.symbolBin: The crossed-out wheeled bin symbol means that the battery must not be disposed of in household waste.
batteryDisposal.symbolPb: Pb = Battery contains more than 0.004 percent lead by mass
batteryDisposal.symbolCd: Cd = Battery contains more than 0.002 percent cadmium by mass
batteryDisposal.symbolHg: Hg = Battery contains more than 0.0005 percent mercury by mass.

consumer.title: Right of withdrawal for consumers
consumer.definition: (A consumer is any natural person who enters into a legal transaction for purposes that are predominantly outside their trade, business, or self-employed professional activity.)

paragraphs.p1: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason.
paragraphs.p2: The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the date the contract is concluded.
paragraphs.p3: To exercise your right of withdrawal, you must inform us (Online Point GmbH, Kurfuerstenstr. 106, 10787 Berlin, phone: 030 403 688 951, email: kontakt@mcrepair.de) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by means of a clear statement (e.g. a letter sent by post, fax or email). You may use the attached model withdrawal form for this purpose, but it is not mandatory.
paragraphs.p4: You may also complete and submit the model withdrawal form or another clear statement electronically on our website (www.mcrepair.de). If you make use of this option, we will send you confirmation of receipt of such withdrawal without delay (e.g. by email).
paragraphs.p5: To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

paragraphs.p1: If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse all payments received from you, including delivery costs (except for any additional costs arising from your choice of a delivery method other than the least expensive standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and no later than fourteen days from the day on which we receive notice of your withdrawal. For this reimbursement, we will use the same means of payment that you used for the original transaction, unless expressly agreed otherwise with you; in any event, you will not be charged any fees for this reimbursement.
paragraphs.p2: If you requested that the services begin during the withdrawal period, you must pay us an amount that is proportionate to what has been provided until the time you notified us of the exercise of the right of withdrawal with respect to this contract, in comparison with the full scope of the services provided for in the contract.

paragraphs.p1: The right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for the provision of services related to leisure activities if the contract provides for a specific date or period of performance.
paragraphs.p2: The right of withdrawal expires in the case of a contract for services once the trader has fully performed the service and began performance only after the consumer gave explicit consent and at the same time acknowledged that they lose their right of withdrawal upon full performance by the trader.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Unless stated otherwise below, the provision of your personal data is not legally or contractually required and is not necessary to conclude a contract. You are not obliged to provide this data. Not providing data has no consequences unless otherwise stated in specific processing operations below.
privacyPage.definition: "Personal data" means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.

serverLogs.title: Server log files
serverLogs.text: You can visit our website without providing personal information. With every access, usage data is transmitted by your browser and stored in protocol data (server log files), including page name, date/time, transferred data volume, and requesting provider. This data is used solely to ensure stable operation and improve our offer. It is not possible to assign this data to a specific person.
serverLogs.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)

contactForm.title: Collection and processing via contact form
contactForm.text1: When using the contact form, we collect your personal data (name, email address, message text) only within the scope provided by you. The processing serves the purpose of contacting you.
contactForm.text2: You can revoke your consent at any time with effect for the future. Your email address is used only for handling your request and deleted afterward unless you agreed to further processing.

recaptcha.title: Use of Google reCAPTCHA
recaptcha.text1: We use the reCAPTCHA service by Google to distinguish whether input is made by a human or by automated processing.
recaptcha.text2: For this purpose, your IP address and additional technical data required by reCAPTCHA may be transmitted to Google.

account.title: Customer account
account.text1: When opening a customer account, we process personal data to improve your shopping experience and simplify order handling.
account.text2: You can revoke your consent at any time. Your account will then be deleted.

orders.title: Collection, processing and use for orders
orders.text1: For orders, we process personal data only to fulfill and execute your order and process related inquiries. Providing data is required to conclude the contract.
orders.text2: Your data is only shared with service partners required for contract fulfillment or processors acting on our behalf.
orders.text3: In all cases we comply with legal requirements and limit transfer to the minimum necessary.
orders.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR (performance of contract)

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.text1: We use a customer review system by Haendlerbund Management AG to collect verified purchase ratings after an order.
reviews.text2: For this purpose, we may contact you by email and use the provider's technical system as processor.
reviews.text3: You can object at any time via the contact details in the imprint or via the link in the review request.
reviews.text4: Data stored in this context is deleted after three months.
reviews.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR (consent) or Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in verified reviews)

newsletter.title: Use of email for newsletters
newsletter.text1: We use your email address for our own newsletter advertising only if you expressly consented.
newsletter.text2: You can revoke your consent at any time via the unsubscribe link or by contacting us.

shippingStatus.title: Email transfer to shipping providers
shippingStatus.text1: If you consent during checkout, we transfer your email address to the shipping provider to inform you about shipment status.
shippingStatus.text2: You can revoke this consent at any time by contacting us or the shipping provider.

erp.title: External merchandise management system
erp.text: To process contracts, we use an external merchandise management system and transfer relevant order data to JTL-Software-GmbH, Rheinstr. 7, 41836 Hueckelhoven, Germany, under a data processing agreement.

paypal.title: Use of PayPal
paypal.text: All PayPal transactions are subject to PayPal's privacy policy:

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: Our website uses cookies. Cookies are small text files stored in your browser to enable recognition and core functionality.
cookies.text2: We use cookies to make our offer more user-friendly, effective and secure.
cookies.text3: We also use cookies for analytics and, where applicable, interest-based advertising.
cookies.text4: Collected data may be pseudonymized and cannot always be assigned to a specific person.
cookies.text5: You have the right to object to processing based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR for reasons arising from your particular situation.
cookies.text6: You can configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Please note that some website functions may then be limited.
cookies.legalBasis: Section 15 para. 3 TMG and Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)

analytics.title: Use of Google Analytics
analytics.text1: We use Google Analytics to analyze website usage and improve our website.
analytics.text2: Google Analytics uses cookies and may transfer information to servers in the USA. IP anonymization is enabled on this website.
analytics.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)
analytics.optOut: You can prevent data collection by Google Analytics using the browser add-on:

remarketing.text1: We use Google's remarketing features to display interest-based advertising.
remarketing.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)

conversionTracking.title: Google Ads conversion tracking
conversionTracking.text1: We use Google Ads conversion tracking to measure campaign effectiveness.
conversionTracking.text2: If you click a Google ad, a conversion cookie is set. These cookies do not directly identify you.
conversionTracking.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)

facebook.title: Facebook remarketing
facebook.text: We use Facebook Custom Audiences to address website visitors with interest-based ads.
facebook.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)
facebook.moreInfo: More information about Facebook privacy is available at

adsense.title: Google AdSense
adsense.text: We use Google AdSense to display targeted advertisements on our website.
adsense.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)
adsense.optOut: You can disable Google cookies permanently via:

bingAds.title: Bing Ads
bingAds.text: We use Bing Ads by Microsoft. Clicking a Bing ad may set a conversion cookie on your device.
bingAds.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)
bingAds.privacyInfo: Microsoft has published privacy information for Bing Ads and related services.

social.title: Social plug-ins using Shariff
social.text1: We use social network plug-ins and privacy-friendly Shariff buttons.
social.text2: Without your explicit interaction, no direct connection to social network servers is established.
social.text3: Only when you click a button are data potentially transmitted to the respective provider.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.text1: We embed YouTube videos in enhanced privacy mode.
youtube.text2: Only when you start a video may information be transmitted to YouTube.

maps.title: Google Maps
maps.text: We use Google Maps to display geographic information and interactive maps.
maps.legalBasis: Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest)

retention.title: Storage duration
retention.text: After complete contract execution, data is stored for warranty periods and statutory retention obligations, then deleted unless further processing was agreed.

rights.title: Data subject rights
rights.intro: If legal requirements are met, you have the following rights under Art. 15 to 20 GDPR:
rights.objection: You also have a right to object under Art. 21 para. 1 GDPR to processing based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR and to direct marketing.
rights.contactText: You can find our contact details in the imprint.

complaint.title: Right to lodge a complaint
complaint.text: Under Art. 77 GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you believe processing of your personal data is unlawful.
complaint.authorityName: Berlin Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information

privacyPage.finalNote: We reserve the right to adapt this privacy policy so it always complies with current legal requirements or to reflect changes in our services. The new privacy policy will apply to your next visit.

vorabdiagnose.heroDesc: Answer a few short questions and find out what repair your device needs.

header.title: About McRepair.de
header.intro: McRepair is one of the leading service providers for the professional repair of smartphones, tablets and notebooks. Our central workshop based in Berlin works with over 350 drop-off locations nationwide and helps you restore your broken device with absolutely reliable and professional specialists.

steps.title: How It Works
steps.step1Desc: Choose your device and the required repair from our extensive range
steps.step2Title: Send or Drop Off Your Device
steps.step2Desc: Use our free shipping service or one of our 350 drop-off locations
steps.step3Title: We repair it quickly and reliably
steps.step3Desc: Our experienced technicians repair your device in just 1-3 business days
steps.step4Title: You receive your repaired device back
steps.step4Desc: Your device will be safely returned to you or can be picked up

whatWeDo.title: What does McRepair do?
whatWeDo.subtitle: Simply put: We repair your smartphone, tablet or notebook
whatWeDo.text: If your smartphone is defective or your tablet is damaged, it is in the best hands with our highly qualified technicians. We are one of the largest repair workshops for smartphones, tablets and notebooks in Germany and can draw on many years of experience. We handle diagnostics and repair - naturally with data preservation. Regardless of whether your Apple iPhone has been dropped or your Samsung Galaxy has charging issues - in many cases it is only minor faults or damage that our specialists can fix quickly and cost-effectively.

whyUs.title: What sets us apart
whyUs.highlightTitle: Over 350 drop-off locations nationwide and a central main workshop with long-experienced technicians.
whyUs.highlightText: For short response times, we always keep high-quality spare parts for all major manufacturers such as Apple or Samsung in large quantities. Thanks to over 350 drop-off locations nationwide, you can also use our convenient and secure service near you. We are constantly expanding our network. If you cannot find a partner in your region, we are always happy to receive new recommendations. The outward and return shipping of your mobile device with our partner DHL is of course free of charge.

locations.title: Our Drop-off Locations
locations.subtitle: Drop-off locations across Germany
locations.text1: Use one of our 350 drop-off locations across Germany to hand over your device conveniently.
locations.text2: Thanks to short turnaround times of just one to three business days, you do not have to go without your smartphone or tablet any longer than absolutely necessary. Put our consistent quality awareness to the test - we will exceed your expectations and quickly make you fully reachable again in your private and professional environment.
locations.text3Bold: Where is the nearest drop-off location?

manufacturers.title: Manufacturers
manufacturers.intro: We carry out repairs for all well-known manufacturers of smartphones, tablets and notebooks. If you have not found your desired manufacturer with us, you are welcome to request an individual price quote for the repair of your device via Contact.
